gloss: One who, or that which, ejects or dispossesses.
A jet jump for lifting water or withdrawing air from a space.
ejector seat: a pilot's seat in an airplane that can be forcibly ejected in the case of an emergency; then the pilot descends by parachute.
That part of the mechanism of a breech-loading firearm which ejects the empty shell.
To compel (a person or persons) to leave.
To throw out or remove forcefully.
To compel (a sports player) to leave the field because of inappropriate behaviour.
To forcefully project oneself or another occupant from an aircraft (or, rarely, another type of vehicle), typically using an ejection seat or escape capsule.
To eject abruptly; to throw out suddenly and swiftly.
To say abruptly.
To eject or suddenly throw fluid or some other substance from a duct or other body structure.
Of a human being or other mammal: to forcibly eject from the urethra in response to sexual stimulation, in a male, semen; and, in a female, vaginal fluid.
Fluid or some other substance ejected or suddenly thrown from a duct or other body structure; specifically, semen or vaginal fluid ejected by a human being or other mammal during an ejaculation.
The act of ejecting or suddenly throwing fluid or some other substance from a duct or other body structure.
A reflex in human beings and other mammals in response to sexual stimulation involving the forcible ejection from the urethra of, in males, semen; and, in females, vaginal fluid.
The act of throwing or darting out with a sudden force and rapid flight.
The uttering of a short, sudden exclamation or prayer, or the exclamation or prayer uttered.
A seat in an aircraft which can be ejected from the cockpit and thus save the pilot's life when a crash is imminent.
The act of ejecting.
That which is ejected.
Material which has been ejected, especially from a volcano or an impact crater.
Of or pertaining to ejaculation.
Of speech, exclamatory.
Able to be ejected.
Either of a pair of ducts through which semen passes, each of which is formed by the merging of the vas deferens and the duct of the seminal vesicle.
